Tidy data frames from verb result objects

Source: R/verb-methods.R
survalis-tidiers.Rd

as.data.frame() methods that return the most useful rectangular view of each result object, for downstream plotting or reporting:

Usage

# S3 method for class 'survalis_eval'
as.data.frame(x, ...)

# S3 method for class 'survalis_tune'
as.data.frame(x, ...)

# S3 method for class 'survalis_compare'
as.data.frame(x, ...)

# S3 method for class 'survalis_estimate'
as.data.frame(x, ...)

Arguments

x

A verb result object.

...

Ignored.

Value

A data frame.

Details

  • survalis_eval – the per-split metric values (id, metric, value).

  • survalis_tune – the scored hyperparameter grid.

  • survalis_compare – the model-by-metric leaderboard (model, metric, mean, se).

  • survalis_estimate – a one-row summary (estimand, tau, estimate, conf.low, conf.high, model).
